notes: Conference paper (Proc. 43rd NSAP conference, March 2018), not 2024 as in pilot_papers.csv. Tagged fodder_banks and trees_in_farmlands, but neither applies: the intervention is a multinutrient feed block (shea nut cake, urea, molasses, Gliricidia leaves) offered to WAD goats as a dry-season supplement; this is balanced supplementation (feed_mgmt). No fodder plot is reserved, so not fodder_banks. Borderline include: the only economic values are production costs of the blocks with three binders (no no-block control, no animal performance or returns). Costs are estimated from prevailing market prices of ingredients at the time of the study; study year not stated. Currency printed as Naira (N with strike) -> NGN.
